hypothesis: Wall-property eligibility might omit iron bars, include secret doors through generic obstruction, or differ on arboreal levels.
supportedSetup: Production lspo_terrain authors a single tested square and neighboring wall; lspo_level_flags optionally enables arboreal. lspo_non_diggable/non_passwall use relative selection_area or no selection; lspo_wall_property uses a singleton relative rectangle. All coordinates valid, no internal field mutation.
expectedC: Exact sel_set_wall_property applies bitwise OR only for IS_STWALL, IS_TREE or IRONBARS. Tested eligible types yield 8 then 24; others add no bits.
observedJS: All 54 fixtures match both cumulative property stages (108 comparisons); type/door metadata unchanged; neighboring wall excluded for local forms and included for whole-map.
control: Ordinary and secret doors, secret corridor, floor and pool are excluded despite nearby eligible wall. Second property retains first. Neighbor distinguishes local from whole-map scope.
scope: Nine authored terrain types × two arboreal states × three public API forms. C callback exact, minimal property accumulator and predicate macros; no full rm union/Lua wrapper execution or finalization equivalence. JS doormask unchanged is a JS-only invariant, not a complete C metadata comparison.
